support.instructions: state.article has the title, meta description and headings of a Vietnamese blog post. state.text is a short Vietnamese phrase printed on the post's cover image; state.role says where it sits (hl = big title, sub = subtitle, head = panel heading, items/steps/chips = list entries). Decide whether the phrase is faithful to the article. Shortened wording, reordering and plain topic labels that fit the article are faithful. Judge meaning, not exact words.

criteria.supported: The phrase restates, summarizes or labels something that the article title, description or headings say or directly imply.
criteria.unsupported: The phrase adds a fact, number, year, claim, promise, tool, brand, step or topic that the article title, description and headings do not contain or imply, or it changes their meaning.

promise.instructions: Does state.text make a superlative or a promise of results, such as best, number one, top ranking guaranteed, sure results, money back?

criteria.no: The phrase is descriptive or instructional and makes no superlative or guarantee.
criteria.yes: The phrase claims to be the best or first, or promises or guarantees a result.
